Stop Killing Games has reached a serious new stage in California. AB 1921, the Protect Our Games Act, has cleared another committee despite ESA opposition, but the bill has changed, its scope is narrower, and the real fight is now over 2027, rereleases, refunds, offline access, and what “ordinary use” means when games go offline.
